sentences.text: Catenibacterium is a bacterial genus proposed for six Eubacterium-like strains isolated from human faeces, with one species, Catenibacterium mitsuokai.
That report describes a metagenomic survey in which a clade within Catenibacterium mitsuokai was significantly more prevalent in non-urbanized than urbanized populations.
A long-read 16S study of 83 Singaporean participants reported that Catenibacterium mitsuokai was significantly altered in the elderly group relative to young individuals.
